offers_products.reason: Makes Schick and Wilkinson Sword razors, Banana Boat and Hawaiian Tropic sunscreen, Skintimate shave gel, and Wet Ones wipes.

offers_services.reason: Sells only branded personal care goods, with no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Shoppers choose its razors, sunscreen and skincare brands, which are sold through stores and online.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Retailers buy its razors, sunscreen and other brands in bulk to resell.

recurring_revenue.reason: Consumers repeatedly buy razor blades, shave gel, wipes and sunscreen, which are consumables.

cyclical_demand.reason: Shaving, skin and feminine care products are everyday staples that people keep buying in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Razors, shave gel, sunscreen and wipes are low-priced items bought often.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured branded goods, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Its end buyers are households. Big retailers are the channel, but consumers choose the brands.

asset_heavy.reason: A brand-led consumer goods company. It has some manufacturing, but it is not heavy-asset like utilities or fleets.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgment call, because the company runs its own manufacturing plants.
